changes.title: Lutnick says Trump’s $5,000 checks for Americans wouldn’t rely on taxpayer funds
changes.summary: President Donald Trump’s promised $5,000 “dividend” for all U.S. adults would not be paid for with taxpayer dollars, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said.

changes.title: Lutnick says promised $5,000 checks for Americans won't come from taxpayer dollars
changes.summary: In a wide-ranging interview, U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick spoke about the $5,000 checks Republicans are promising if they win the midterms, the Trump administration's trade war with Canada and rising energy costs. NBC News’ Christine Romans reports.
